description: Which vulnerabilities in this vendor's products should I patch first?. Joins NVD CVE records (CVSS), FIRST EPSS exploit probability and the CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog for one vendor (optionally one product) and returns a patch order with tiers, KEV due dates and a summary (expected exploited count, top CWEs). Ranking computed by Lilambd. Routes: /answer (vendor*, product, days, limit, offset); /kev-recent (days, vendor, limit). Paid $0.5 USDC per call via x402 (_meta["x402/payment"]); set sample=true for a free 3-row preview.

route.description: One of: /answer, /kev-recent. Replace {placeholders} with a value, e.g. /search or /HND.

name: cve-priority
